Generate plots for Bayesian item response theory models

Source: R/BayesIRTplot.R
BayesIRTplot.Rd

Generate plots for Bayesian item response theory (IRT) models fitted in blavaan. BayesIRTplot() reads in a fitted IRT model from blavaan. The current version supports unidimensional two-parameter IRT models for binary items. Available plots include Item-Person Map (IPM), Item Characteristic Curve (ICC), Item Information Curve (IIC), Test Characteristic Curve (TCC), Test Information Curve (TIC), and Marginal Reliability Plot (REL).

Usage

BayesIRTplot(
  blavaanobj,
  IRTplot = "ALL",
  DrawsK = 50,
  items_IPM = "ALL",
  items_ICC_IIC = "ALL",
  item_names_ICC_IIC = NULL,
  plot_option_ICC_IIC = "separate",
  max_plots_panel = 9,
  ncol_panel = 3,
  overlay_style = "color",
  print_plots = TRUE,
  save_plots = FALSE,
  save_dir = getwd(),
  dpi = 300
)

Arguments

blavaanobj

A fitted IRT model from blavaan.

IRTplot

Types of IRT plots to generate. Can be one or more of the following:

  • IPM: Item-Person Map

  • ICC: Item Characteristic Curve

  • IIC: Item Information Curve

  • TCC: Test Characteristic Curve

  • TIC: Test Information Curve

  • REL: Marginal Reliability Plot

  • ALL (default): All plots listed above

DrawsK

Controls the number of posterior draws plotted as separate lines in ICC, IIC, TCC and TIC. Default to 50. The first DrawsK posterior draws are plotted (i.e., the posterior draws are not randomly selected). If DrawsK exceeds the number of available posterior draws, all available posterior draws are plotted. Note that in those plots, the mean probabilities or the mean information are calculated using all posterior draws from blavaan fitted object regardless of how many posterior draws are plotted as separate lines. This option does not affect IPM and REL plots which always use all posterior draws.

items_IPM

A list of items which will be included in IPM. By default, all items will be plotted.

items_ICC_IIC

A list of items for which ICC and IIC will be generated. By default, ICC and IIC of all items will be generated.

item_names_ICC_IIC

A list of item names to be displayed on ICC and IIC (optional). Should be of the same length as items_ICC_IIC.

plot_option_ICC_IIC

Types of ICC and IIC plots to generate. Can be one or more of the following:

  • separate (default): each item in a separate plot

  • panel: several items plotted in a panel (small multiples, faceted plot)

  • overlay: several items overlaid in one plot

Note that in overlaid ICC and IIC plots, only the mean probabilities of a correct response or the mean item information across all posterior draws will be plotted (no separate lines for each posterior draw).

max_plots_panel

In panel ICC and IIC plots, controls the maximum number of items to be plotted in one panel. Default to 9.

ncol_panel

In panel ICC and IIC plots, controls the number of columns in one panel. Default to 3.

overlay_style

In overlaid ICC and IIC plots, controls the way to distinguish different items:

  • color (default): different items are plotted in different colors

  • line: different items are plotted in different line types

Note that if overlay_style = "line", a maximum of 13 items can be plotted.

print_plots

Should plots be printed? Logical; default to TRUE.

save_plots

Should plots be saved? Logical; default to FALSE.

save_dir

Directory where plots will be saved when save_plots = TRUE. Defaults to the current working directory returned by getwd(). Absolute path or relative path within the current working directory may be provided.

dpi

If save_plots = TRUE, specifies the resolution (dots per inch) used when saving the plot. Default to 300.

Value

A list of ggplot objects corresponding to the requested IRT plots.

Depending on the requested plots and plotting options, the list may contain:

  • IPMplot: Item-Person Map

  • ICCplot_item1, ICCplot_item2, ...: Item Characteristic Curves by item

  • ICCplot_panel1, ICCplot_panel2, ...: Item Characteristic Curves by panel

  • ICCplot_overlay: Item Characteristic Curves overlaid

  • IICplot_item1, IICplot_item2, ...: Item Information Curves by item

  • IICplot_panel1, IICplot_panel2, ...: Item Information Curves by panel

  • IICplot_overlay: Item Information Curves overlaid

  • TCCplot: Test Characteristic Curve

  • TICplot: Test Information Curve

  • RELplot: Marginal Reliability Plot

Details

ICC, IIC, TCC, and TIC are plotted over a latent trait (theta) range of -6 to 6.

Examples

BayesIRTplot(tma.IRT.fitted.model)













































# access individual plot
plots <- BayesIRTplot(tma.IRT.fitted.model, print_plots = FALSE)
plots$IPMplot
